merge_cfg_from_file: merge a YAML config file into the global Detectron cfg to override default training and model options
merge_cfg_from_list: merge command line config key value pairs like TEST.NMS 0.5 into the global Detectron cfg
merge_cfg_from_cfg: merge another AttrDict config object into the global Detectron cfg to override specific settings
assert_and_infer_cfg: assert and infer the global Detectron cfg values then cache URLs and make the config immutable
get_output_dir: get or create the output directory path for a given dataset based on the current global config
